title: Two Laredo Men Sentenced to Federal Prison in Card Fraud Scheme
excerpt: Two Laredo men were sentenced to federal prison after a fraud scheme compromised more than 1,500 card numbers, including a skimmer found inside a gas pump at a Valero in Laredo.
content:
Two Laredo men are headed to federal prison after a fraud scheme compromised more than 1,500 card numbers, according to KGNS.

Liover Leon-Hernandez was sentenced to nearly four years in prison, and Orlandi Castillo Leon received just over three years, federal prosecutors said.

The investigation began after a U.S. Customs and Border Protection agent reported fraudulent charges on his government travel card, according to prosecutors.

Surveillance video showed the two men using other people's card accounts to buy gift cards and personal items, prosecutors said.

Investigators later found a card skimmer inside a gas pump at a Valero in Laredo. During a search of the men's home, authorities said Leon-Hernandez tried to swallow a thumb drive containing 1,530 stolen card numbers.

Both men are expected to face removal proceedings after serving their sentences.

Source: KGNS, Nov. 19, 2026.
